post.text: Man sells his wife's wedding ring after he found out he was cheating on him and this was her reaction https://t.co/b8PiIeVyg9
post.author_description: Masculinity. Exposing the female nature. Author

description.description: A man in a dark grey hoodie and a woman in a light grey sweatshirt are in a kitchen with dark cabinets and granite countertops. The man takes a white cloth or paper towel and begins vigorously wiping down the surface of the granite island, while the woman stands by watching him.

tweetMedia.transcription: I'm stressed. I can't find my rings. Do you know where they are? Your wedding rings? Yeah, what other rings have I ever worn? Um, I, somebody, I think somebody else has them. What do you mean? Like who? I don't know. I've never bought them from the pawn shop that I gave it to. What are you talking about? I've sold your rings. Why? Because you're cheating on me. What the fuck are you talking about? You've been acting super weird lately. What are you talking about? Have you not noticed like the dumb stuff that you've been doing? you've been coming home late from work every day telling me that you're somewhere that you're not you share your location with me so i see where you're at if you tell me you're going to the bar you're not you're in some neighborhood okay and some house all the time okay and you haven't thought to like maybe just have a conversation with me and ask me like what's going on i don't like not paying attention no i don't need to because i know that you're cheating on me because i saw that you have an active tinder account too okay but that doesn't give you the right to sell my rings. They're mine. No, they're mine. I earned them for you. I paid $25,000 for them for you. For you to make the vows to be faithful to me. And you are not. So you don't deserve those rings. And you don't deserve me either. So with that money that I got from the rings, I'm hiring an attorney and I'm filing for a divorce. You're fucking kidding. I'm not kidding. See if I'm kidding. Wait. Wait until I have money to reach out to you. Why? I don't understand. You're blowing this way out of proportion. You haven't even asked me. Still, what's going on? I don't need to ask you. I have the proof. Okay, but haven't you thought maybe that you're the reason this is happening? I don't care what the reason is. It still does not justify you cheating on your husband and being unfaithful. If you're unhappy, then divorce me. And then do what you want to do.
